biggest_gap.title: The command palette cannot run any module action: 'open any screen, record or action by typing' covers only shell actions
biggest_gap.detail: The palette finds screens and records: users, roles, companies and branches (round 4's record gap is fixed). The only actions it lists are the shell's own: switch language, Arabic digits, preferences, shortcuts, navigation pane, print this screen and sign out. Typing 'new', 'new user', 'invite', 'new role', 'new company', 'new branch', 'export', 'copy role', 'unblock' or 'sign-in history' returns nothing. It returns nothing on the Users screen either, where 'new', 'export' and 'columns' also find nothing, though the screen itself has New user (Alt+N), Print or export (Alt+Shift+R), Columns and Views. The cause is the extension contract (web/src/kernel/extensions.ts): modules can give the palette record sources only, with no way to contribute actions. Every later module (invoices, purchase orders, journal entries) will inherit a palette that can find a record but cannot start one or run its commands. For a keyboard-first UAE trading office that is the main promise of the palette. Fix: add a permission-filtered 'actions' contribution to ModuleExtensions (title EN/AR, chord, run or path, optional screen context), register the existing toolbar actions of identity and tenancy (new user, new role, copy role, new company, new branch, print or export the list), and show the current screen's actions first. Add vitest and e2e checks, and a G2 screen plant (an action offered without its permission).
biggest_gap.evidence: drivers/explore2.cjs and drivers/explore3.cjs against the demo (./erp up on port 20450): explore3.json 'palette.empty' lists the actions group as only Switch the interface to Arabic / Arabic-Indic digits / Open my preferences / Show keyboard shortcuts / Move to the navigation pane / Show or hide the navigation pane / Print this screen / Sign out. explore2.json shows 'palette:new user' [], 'palette:new role' [], 'palette:new company' [], 'palette:export' [], 'palette@users:new' [] and 'palette@users:export' []. [route: p00-foundation] The ./erp verify cleanup does not end every stage process when verify itself is stopped with SIGTERM. After I stopped my contaminated first run, its e2e stage loop (bash ./erp verify, tee e2e.log, sed '[e2e]') kept waiting for a dotnet.status in the deleted temp folder. Those processes inherited the slot's fd 9, so slot 1 stayed held for about 40 minutes and blocked the machine's verify queue. I killed my own PIDs 88614/88617/88620 to free it. verify_cleanup should kill each stage's process group, or the slot fd should be closed in stage children (9>&-).

The open-third-user-keyboard ours driver from r4 failed verification on this build: the record opens at /identity/users/<id> and its panel shows 'Loading…' when the old URL-only wait ends. I fixed the driver to wait for the record's e-mail in the panel; the fixed driver is in drivers/compare-task/ours-driver.mjs.
Machine seconds for the comparisons were measured while two other critics' verifies ran (load average about 40-80). Ours still won every machine-seconds measure by 4x or more.
